In the second Ga site, Ga is bonded to six O atoms to form GaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent GaO₆ octahedra. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three GaO₆ octahedra and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 37-60°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.66 Å. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 37-59°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.66 Å. In the fourth Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three GaO₆ octahedra and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-60°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.66 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites.
